# gravity_role_monitoring (Resource)

Configuration of the monitoring role, which serves health checks and metrics.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gravity_role_monitoring" "monitoring" {
  port = 8009
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `port` (Number) Defaults to `8009`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Role configurations are singletons, identified by the role name
terraform import gravity_role_monitoring.monitoring 'monitoring'
```
